# NEON DROP

NEON DROP is a free, mobile-first browser arcade game created by Donacgreece.
Players drag a glowing ball left and right to pass through neon gates. Each run
starts with three lives and becomes progressively faster. No account is needed.

Official game: https://donacgreece.github.io/NeonDrop/
Source: https://github.com/Donacgreece/NeonDrop

The game stores player names, settings and Top 10 scores locally on the user's
device. It does not collect personal information.
